entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Neither clerk nor other customers are present.

entries.text_jp: 無気味だな ここは
entries.translation_en: This place is thoroughly eerie.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:この店のモノって
entries.translation_en: Brown: Can we eat the stuff in this store for free?

entries.text_jp: このコンビニ どうみても
entries.translation_en: No matter how you look at it, this convenience store is totally abandoned.

entries.text_jp: 菱美旡生をつねりますか?
entries.translation_en: Pinch Nurse Hizumi?

entries.text_jp: 菱美旡生:あっち行って!
entries.translation_en: Nurse: Go away!

entries.text_jp: む   い大石枚長をつねりますか?
entries.translation_en: Pinch Principal Oishi?

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:なんだ!?ここ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: What the hell is this place?!

entries.text_jp: ???:…あら…まぁ
???:そうだね…
entries.translation_en: ???: Indeed...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:なんだ?彼女は
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What is this? She is wearing our school's uniform...

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:ひょ{204}う!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Whew! Check out that cute chick!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:ねぇ アンタ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Hey, you! Are you the boss of this tower?!

entries.text_jp: ???:うふふ
entries.translation_en: ???: Ufufu...

entries.text_jp: ここは 私の
entries.translation_en: This place is my...

entries.text_jp: 私のためだけの 夢
entries.translation_en: a dream solely for me.

entries.text_jp: そう この｜ヒュプノスの塔』の守護を雪の女王よりまかされた
entries.translation_en: Yes, I was entrusted by the Snow Queen to guard this "Tower of Hypnos".

entries.text_jp: 私 ｜広臘 久美』の夢なのよ
entries.translation_en: I am "Kumi Hirose", and this is my dream.

entries.text_jp: ヒュプノス:そうだね 久美
entries.translation_en: Hypnos: That is right, Kumi.

entries.text_jp: どうする 久美?
entries.translation_en: What will you do, Kumi?

entries.text_jp: あいつら ちょっと
entries.translation_en: Those guys are getting a little annoying.

entries.text_jp: なぜ ひと思いに殺さず
entries.translation_en: Why not kill them in one stroke,

entries.text_jp: では あなた運が学枚の人引を
entries.translation_en: So, did you turn the people at school into ice?

entries.text_jp: 久美:…ふ…うふふふ…
entries.translation_en: Kumi: ...Heh... Ufufufu...

entries.text_jp: しかたないわね あなたたちも
entries.translation_en: Can't be helped then. Why don't you all live in my dream world too?

entries.text_jp: ヒュプノス:そうだね 久美
entries.translation_en: Hypnos: That is right, Kumi.

entries.text_jp: でも あいつらが
entries.translation_en: But those fools will never understand.

entries.text_jp: 久美のこと 理解できない
entries.translation_en: They cannot comprehend Kumi.

entries.text_jp: あいつらは 久美が
entries.translation_en: They think Kumi is just running away.

entries.text_jp: さ 見せてやろう
entries.translation_en: Come, let us show them.

entries.text_jp: そして 教えてやろう!
entries.translation_en: And let us teach them a lesson!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:え…何!?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Wh-What the hell?!

entries.text_jp: うの彼:えっ?ありゃ?
entries.translation_en: Boyfriend: Huh? Whoa?

entries.text_jp: 演馴部部長:ちょっと広臘さん
entries.translation_en: Drama Club President: Excuse me, Hirose-san!

entries.text_jp: あなた最近 演馴部の練瓷に
entries.translation_en: You haven't been showing up to drama club practice lately!

entries.text_jp: みんな いっしょうけんめい
entries.translation_en: Everyone is working as hard as they can!

entries.text_jp: 演馴部貢:そ{204}だよ 久美
entries.translation_en: Drama Club Member: That's right, Kumi!

entries.text_jp: 選ばれといて それはないよね
entries.translation_en: After being chosen for the lead role, you can't just flake on us!

entries.text_jp: あんた もしかして
entries.translation_en: Don't tell me you think studying is more important?

entries.text_jp: 演馴部貢:でも マジな話
entries.translation_en: Drama Club Member: But seriously,

entries.text_jp: 台謁あわせ
entries.translation_en: without reading lines together, we cannot put on the play!

entries.text_jp: 演馴部貢:うわちゃ{204}
entries.translation_en: Drama Club Member: Yeesh~

entries.text_jp: さすが クラスいちのガリ勉の
entries.translation_en: As expected of the number-one bookworm in class, acting all high and mighty!

entries.text_jp: 演馴部貢:なによそれ!
entries.translation_en: Drama Club Member: What is that supposed to mean?!

entries.text_jp: 大事なら 部活なんて
entries.translation_en: If tests are all you care about, quit the club already!

entries.text_jp: 演馴部部長:まぁ いいわ
entries.translation_en: Drama Club President: Very well.

entries.text_jp: 私を…いいえ 部活を
entries.translation_en: If you look down on me... no, on the drama club,

entries.text_jp: という雫匝の宇での 今の
entries.translation_en: then understand your place within this group!

entries.text_jp: もしそれがわからないのなら
entries.translation_en: If you cannot understand that, then get lost!
Drama Club Member: Yeah! That's right!

entries.text_jp: いるだけで 不偸快よ!
entries.translation_en: Just having you around makes everyone miserable!

entries.text_jp: 演馴部貢:かわいそうだけど
entries.translation_en: Drama Club Member: It's harsh, but you brought this on yourself.

entries.text_jp: よく考えな 久美
entries.translation_en: Think long and hard about it, Kumi.

entries.text_jp: う れない…
entries.translation_en: I cannot take it anymore...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:へぇ………
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Heh... So that was it, huh?

entries.text_jp: 今のが アンタが夢の械晃に
entries.translation_en: Is that the reason you ran away into the dream world?

entries.text_jp: ……で だからなんなんだい?
entries.translation_en: ...So? What about it?

entries.text_jp: 久美:あ…あなた
entries.translation_en: Kumi: Y-You...

entries.text_jp: 今の みてなにも感じないの?
entries.translation_en: Didn't you feel anything seeing that?!

entries.text_jp: すぐに私のつらさ 悲しみを
entries.translation_en: You should understand my pain and sorrow immediately!

entries.text_jp: ヒュプノス:お 藩ち善いて
entries.translation_en: Hypnos: Calm down, Kumi.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:よォよォ!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Yo, yo! Kumi-chan, aren't you overthinking life a bit too much?

entries.text_jp: 久美ちゃ{204}ん キミってェ
entries.translation_en: Kumi-chan, you're making things way too difficult for yourself!

entries.text_jp: 人生 ムツかしく
entries.translation_en: Why make life so complicated?

entries.text_jp: フンワカいこうよフンワカさぁ
entries.translation_en: Take it easy and breezy, just chill out~

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:な{204}にさ!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: What's with you?! Playing the victim all by yourself!
Anyway, blaming others is just totally uncool!

entries.text_jp: もォ 信じらんない!
entries.translation_en: Geez, I can't believe this girl!

entries.text_jp: 久美:だって…だって……!
entries.translation_en: Kumi: But... but...!

entries.text_jp: 何をしても しなくても!
entries.translation_en: No matter what I did or didn't do, everyone blamed me!

entries.text_jp: 私は 私なりに
entries.translation_en: I was just trying my best in my own way!

entries.text_jp: ヒュプノス:そうとも!
entries.translation_en: Hypnos: Indeed! You did nothing wrong, Kumi!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:…｜他の人間』…か?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: ..."Other people"... is that it?

entries.text_jp: ふん 杲だったのだなァ…
entries.translation_en: Hmph. Truly a cowardly way of living.

entries.text_jp: そのうえ 逃げるのも
entries.translation_en: And fleeing from the very burden of living...

entries.text_jp: 黠局手達は 現実の械晃と
entries.translation_en: In the end, you merely refuse to face reality.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:｜他の人間』ですか?
entries.translation_en: Elly: "Other people", is it?

entries.text_jp: 久美:な 何達のつもりなの?!あなたたち!
entries.translation_en: Kumi: Wh-Who do you think you are?! All of you!

entries.text_jp: ヒュプノス:もういい!
entries.translation_en: Hypnos: Enough!

entries.text_jp: もう…いいよ 久美
entries.translation_en: It's all right now, Kumi.

entries.text_jp: こいつらをヤってしまおう
entries.translation_en: Let us destroy these intruders!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:およしよ 独がりは
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Quit trying to act tough.

entries.text_jp: だったら ここにいる
entries.translation_en: Then defeating the Hypnos here will wake everyone up, right?

entries.text_jp: アンタ運は 塔のどこかにいる
entries.translation_en: You guys must be projections from somewhere in this tower.

entries.text_jp: ｜広臘 久美』の夢が
entries.translation_en: The dream created by "Kumi Hirose"...

entries.text_jp: つまりアタシらがアンタを
entries.translation_en: In other words, if we defeat you, the dream ends!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:あの 久美ってコが
entries.translation_en: Yukino: That Kumi girl is hiding on the top floor, isn't she?

entries.text_jp: 超 むかつく女よね
entries.translation_en: Ayase: What a totally annoying chick, honestly!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:なんなのだ!あの女は!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What is with that woman?! Self-absorbed to the core!

entries.text_jp: ちょっと わかっちゃうゼ
entries.translation_en: Brown: But y'know, I kinda get where she's coming from...

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:Kumiさんの
entries.translation_en: Elly: Kumi-san's loneliness must have been overwhelming...

entries.text_jp: 久美:何 何なの!
entries.translation_en: Kumi: Wh-What is it?!

entries.text_jp: わ 私に手を申したら
entries.translation_en: I-If you lay a hand on me, Hypnos will destroy you!

entries.text_jp: 久美をつねりますか?
entries.translation_en: Pinch Kumi?

entries.text_jp: 久美:い いい利剖ね
entries.translation_en: Kumi: Wh-What a terrible judge of character you are!

entries.text_jp: ただしくん:…だいじょうぶ
entries.translation_en: Tadashi: ...It's all right, Tamaki-chan. I'm right here.

entries.text_jp: ほ だから
entries.translation_en: Tadashi: See? I told you so!

entries.text_jp: たまきちゃん:いつもケンカ
entries.translation_en: Tamaki: We were always fighting, but...

entries.text_jp: ほっておくと いっつも
entries.translation_en: Tamaki: If I leave you alone, you always get into trouble!

entries.text_jp: でも あの夢のおかげで
entries.translation_en: Tamaki: But thanks to that dream,

entries.text_jp: やっと 素直になれそう…
entries.translation_en: I feel like I can finally be honest with myself...

entries.text_jp: ほ 大好き!
entries.translation_en: Tamaki: I love you, Tadashi!

entries.text_jp: やってる やってる
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Look at them go, all lovey-dovey.

entries.text_jp: ま これで三人とも無事
entries.translation_en: Well, at least all three are safe and sound.

entries.text_jp: 身体は 大夫夬かい?
entries.translation_en: Are you feeling all right physically?
Tadashi: Ah! Ahhh! Not you guys again!

entries.text_jp: ジャマ しないでよ!
entries.translation_en: Tadashi: Don't interrupt us!

entries.text_jp: ねェ たまきちゃん
entries.translation_en: Tadashi: Right, Tamaki-chan?

entries.text_jp: たまきちゃん:…黛さん
entries.translation_en: Tamaki: ...Mayuzumi-san, thank you for waking us up.

entries.text_jp: まさに 時間の無驟 肪け掲
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Truly a colossal waste of time. Wasted rescue effort.

entries.text_jp: だった というわけだ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: That is what this amounted to.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:え{204}!なァんだよゥ
entries.translation_en: Brown: What the heck?! That's so cold, Tamaki-chan!

entries.text_jp: つめてェなァ たまきちゃん
entries.translation_en: Brown: Treating us so coldly after all we did!

entries.text_jp: おれ達が あ{204}んなに苦労して
entries.translation_en: Brown: We worked our butts off to rescue you two!

entries.text_jp: なァんも おぼえてないの?
entries.translation_en: Don't you remember anything at all?

entries.text_jp: おれ達 超 悲しいゼ
entries.translation_en: Brown: The great me is super heartbroken!

entries.text_jp: ただしくん:おぼえてるも何も
entries.translation_en: Tadashi: What do you mean remember...? We were just having a sweet dream!

entries.text_jp: ほ …あれ??
entries.translation_en: Tadashi: ...Huh??

entries.text_jp: 目が覚めたら 目の前に
entries.translation_en: Tadashi: When I woke up, Tamaki-chan was right in front of me,

entries.text_jp: たまきちゃんもおれのコト
entries.translation_en: Tadashi: and she was gazing at me with such loving eyes!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:ハイハイハイハイ!!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: All right, all right, we get it!!

entries.text_jp: ほ わかったよ!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: We understand completely!

entries.text_jp: これだけ 教えてくれないか?
entries.translation_en: Just tell us one thing, will ya?

entries.text_jp: そしたら 二人のお邪魔は
entries.translation_en: After that, we won't get in the way

entries.text_jp: もう しないよ
entries.translation_en: of you two lovebirds anymore.

entries.text_jp: それで
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: So then,

entries.text_jp: どっちか ｜鍖の破片』を
entries.translation_en: do either of you happen to have a "Mirror Shard"?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:うむ はなから
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Indeed, I did not expect much from the start, but...

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:今 学枚を敕うため
entries.translation_en: Elly: To save the school, it is an item we desperately need.

entries.text_jp: 沚当たり ありませんか?
entries.translation_en: Elly: Does anything come to mind?

entries.text_jp: たまきちゃん:…もう!
entries.translation_en: Tamaki-chan: ...Geez! Tadashi, be serious!

entries.text_jp: ｜鍖の破片』て これかな?
entries.translation_en: Tamaki: A "Mirror Shard"... could it be this?

entries.text_jp: お…おれ そんなモノ
entries.translation_en: Tadashi: Th-That you had something like that...

entries.text_jp: 鹿が 持ってるなんて…
entries.translation_en: Tadashi: I never heard you had that on you...!

entries.text_jp: ほ なのに!
entries.translation_en: Tadashi: Even though we pledged our love to each other!

entries.text_jp: ひどいや ひどいや!
entries.translation_en: Tadashi: Keeping secrets is so mean!

entries.text_jp: たまきちゃん:…ちょっと!
entries.translation_en: Tamaki-chan: ...Hold on! I only just found it in my pocket!

entries.text_jp: はい これでよければ
entries.translation_en: Tamaki: Here, if this helps, please take it.

entries.text_jp: ごめんね こんな事くらいしか
entries.translation_en: Tamaki: Sorry that this is all I can do to help...

entries.text_jp: ホントはあたしやただしも
entries.translation_en: Tamaki: Honestly, Tadashi and I wish we could come along, but...

entries.text_jp: ｜かがみのはへん』を手に入れた
entries.translation_en: Obtained the 'Mirror Shard'.

entries.text_jp: ただしくん:う{204}ん
entries.translation_en: Tadashi-kun: Yeah...

entries.translation_en: Ayase: ...

たまきちゃんとただしくんが

entries.translation_en: Nurse: ...So noisy...

entries.text_jp: ほ みぃ…?

そろそろ 覬玉を
アヤセ:ただしくんッて
entries.translation_en: Ayase: ...

リ{204}ダ{204}の素質 抜群だゼ!!

ほ 残ってるわけでは

entries.translation_en: Elly: Coincidentally, Hypnos

entries.text_jp: なってしまったわけですわね
entries.translation_en: Elly: We would only end up being dead weight, it seems.
Tadashi: Ah! Ahhh! Take care, you guys!

entries.text_jp: ただしくん:もう注事は
entries.translation_en: Tadashi-kun: Your business is done, right? Leave us alone now!

entries.text_jp: してくれないかな 頼むよ
entries.translation_en: Tadashi: Please give us some privacy, I beg of you.

entries.text_jp: たまきちゃん:あたしと
entries.translation_en: Tamaki-chan: Are you trying to get between me and Tadashi?

entries.text_jp: たまきちゃん:ごめんね
entries.translation_en: Tamaki-chan: Sorry, I can only think about Tadashi right now.

entries.text_jp: いまは ただしのコトしか
entries.translation_en: Tamaki: I really cannot focus on anything else.

entries.text_jp: ほ どぉ?…
entries.translation_en: Ayase: How is it...? Sensei?

entries.text_jp: ほ …しい?…
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Does it hurt...?

entries.text_jp: 菱美旡生:うううッ!!
entries.translation_en: Nurse: Ughhh!! My head is pounding...

entries.text_jp: なんかとってもいいトコで
entries.translation_en: Nurse: I was just at the best part of my dream, too...

entries.text_jp: け  かかゃのない学枚に戻したいぜ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Let's turn this school back to normal without ice!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:ようやく
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Finally awake, huh, teachers?!

entries.text_jp: 身体のほう 大夫夬?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: How are you feeling? Any injuries?

entries.text_jp: こりゃ どういうことだ!?
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: What on earth is the meaning of this?!

entries.text_jp: ここは どこなんだ!?
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: Where in the world is this place?!

entries.text_jp: ほ お前運の汢業か!
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: Is this your doing, you delinquents?!

entries.text_jp: この 不箕生徒ども!
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: You good-for-nothing brats!

entries.text_jp: こ 枚長もこの不箕どもに
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: Principal, say something to these troublemakers!

entries.text_jp: 大石枚長:藩ちつきましたか?
entries.translation_en: Principal Oishi: Have you calmed down? Are you unharmed?

entries.text_jp: ほ ……黛さん 皆さん
entries.translation_en: Principal Oishi: ...Mayuzumi-san, everyone, thank you.

entries.text_jp: ほ なければよろしい
entries.translation_en: Principal Oishi: If no one is hurt, that is good.

entries.text_jp: そんなことより 旡生方
entries.translation_en: Yukino: More importantly, teachers, do you have a Mirror Shard?

entries.text_jp: 不箕どもは ひでぇッスよゥ
entries.translation_en: Brown: Calling us delinquents is so cruel, Vice Principal!

entries.text_jp: そりゃあぁ もォ苦労して
entries.translation_en: Brown: We went through hell and back to save you guys!

entries.text_jp: ほ を
entries.translation_en: Brown: A little word of thanks...

entries.text_jp: 言って歓しいなぁ おれ達
entries.translation_en: Brown: ...would be nice for the great me and my team!

entries.text_jp: ほ いいやな!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Ah, whatever! Forget it!

entries.text_jp: ねぇ 知らねぇっスか?
entries.translation_en: Brown: Hey, do you guys know about the Mirror Shard?

entries.text_jp: ああ これのことか?
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: Ah, you mean this thing?

entries.text_jp: 齟が今年 耗職するんだけど
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: My suit pocket tore because of this jagged thing!

entries.text_jp: ほ まあ
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: Well,

entries.text_jp: そんなコトはどうでもいいか
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: none of that matters right now.

entries.text_jp: ほ どうでもいいな!!
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: Who cares about that anyway?!

entries.text_jp: ところで!手達運 こんな物で
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: By the way! What are you brats planning to do with this?!

entries.text_jp: ほ だめだ!
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: No! Giving this to you will only make things worse!

entries.text_jp: ほ なによ!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: What did you say?! You bald Hannya!!

entries.text_jp: だから あんたは枚長センセと
entries.translation_en: Ayase: That's why unlike Principal Oishi, everyone hates you!

entries.text_jp: さっさと破片 よこせよ!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Hand over the shard already!

entries.text_jp: 大石枚長:まぁ まぁ
entries.translation_en: Principal Oishi: Now, now, calm down everyone.

entries.text_jp: 綾臘さん だめよ
entries.translation_en: Principal Oishi: Ayase-san, a lady must not use such harsh words.

entries.text_jp: まず 生徒と同じ目檪で物事を
entries.translation_en: Principal Oishi: First, try looking at things from the students' perspective.

entries.text_jp: みてみるようにしてくださいな
entries.translation_en: Principal Oishi: Please give them the Mirror Shard.

entries.text_jp: ｜かがみのはへん』を手に入れた
entries.translation_en: Obtained the "Mirror Shard".

entries.text_jp: 南茱:ふん
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Hmph. You should have handed it over obediently from the start.

entries.text_jp: いま 学枚で真にただしき道を
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: The only ones walking the truly righteous path in this school are ourselves.

entries.text_jp: でも これは私運にとっても
entries.translation_en: Elly: This is an indispensable treasure for us,

entries.text_jp: いいえ 学枚を敕うためにも
entries.translation_en: Elly: and furthermore, essential to saving the school.

entries.text_jp: 大石枚長:いまは
entries.translation_en: Principal Oishi: For now, I shall not ask your reasons.

entries.text_jp: でも くれぐれも無茶はだめよ
entries.translation_en: Principal Oishi: But please, do not do anything reckless.

entries.text_jp: さ 行きなさい
entries.translation_en: Principal Oishi: Go on ahead, students.

entries.text_jp: 反谷教腹:ふん!もう止めん
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: Hmph! I won't stop you anymore. Go!

entries.text_jp: ほ …………おい お前ら!
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: ...Hey, you brats!

entries.text_jp: もし…もしも 学枚が
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: If... if the school returns to normal...

entries.text_jp: その時 この事怒の説畍を
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: assemble in the Principal's office immediately!

entries.text_jp: たっぷり してもらうからな!
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: You will give me a full lecture and explanation!

entries.text_jp: ほ 禾いよ!全貢だ!
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: Come! All of you, be prepared!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:こ…
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Geez, what a stubborn old man.

entries.text_jp: ほ まかしときな!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Leave it to us! We'll save the school for sure!

entries.text_jp: 的車は必ず まもるよ!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: We'll definitely protect everyone!

entries.text_jp: ほ ｜必ず』ね!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: "Without fail", you can count on it!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:この部厘でやることは
entries.translation_en: Yukino: There's nothing left to do in this room, is there?

entries.text_jp: もう 何もないんじゃないか?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: We should hurry on ahead.

entries.text_jp: 旡を念ぐべきだよ 多分
entries.translation_en: Yukino: We gotta move fast.

entries.text_jp: 超 見直してくれるよね!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Vice Principal will totally look at us in a new light now!

entries.text_jp: ま 無事にこしたことはない
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: At any rate, it is best that our teachers are unharmed.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:よォ{204}し!
entries.translation_en: Brown: All right! Hannya owes the great me a huge favor now!

entries.text_jp: これで ハンニャ教腹は
entries.translation_en: Brown: Now Vice Principal Hannya can't act all bossy around us!

entries.text_jp: けけけッ!もォ でけぇ顔は
entries.translation_en: Brown: Kekeke! No more strutting around like he owns the place!

entries.text_jp: ほ ッて
entries.translation_en: Brown: ...Though saying that to his face is kinda terrifying!

entries.text_jp: やっぱ コワイぜ…教腹!
entries.translation_en: Brown: He really is scary, that Vice Principal!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:なんにせよ
entries.translation_en: Elly: In any case, that the teachers are safe is a relief.

entries.text_jp: 反谷教腹:う{204}ん
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: Yeah... What a strange dream that was...

entries.text_jp: それにしても いい夢だった…
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: Even so, it was a good dream...

entries.text_jp: ああッ あと少しで
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: Ahh, just a little more and I could remember it!

entries.text_jp: 大石枚長:それにしても
entries.translation_en: Principal Oishi: Even so, it was quite an unpleasant nightmare.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:うわあッ?!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Whoa?! What is this room?!

entries.text_jp: う 芋宙?!なんだってんだい
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Outer space?! What kind of room is this?!

entries.text_jp: はじめまして みなさん
entries.translation_en: Kumi: Nice to meet you, everyone.

entries.text_jp: 私 雪の女王からこの塔の
entries.translation_en: Kumi: Entrusted by the Snow Queen to guard this tower,

entries.text_jp: と いいます
entries.translation_en: Kumi: my name is Kumi.

entries.text_jp: みなさんを 殺せって
entries.translation_en: Kumi: I was ordered to kill all of you, but...

entries.text_jp: なにも言わずに 隆伏して
entries.translation_en: Kumi: why not quietly surrender and live happily with us in dreams?

entries.text_jp: 杲しく くらしません?
entries.translation_en: Kumi: Wouldn't that be wonderful?

entries.text_jp: ｜広臘 久美です』?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: "I am Kumi Hirose"? A young girl guarding this tower?!

entries.text_jp: 定談ではない 笶わせるな!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Do not make me laugh with such absurd jokes!

entries.text_jp: 手達 我が枚の刷服を
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: You wear our school uniform. What are you doing here?!

entries.text_jp: キミみたいな かわいい齟が
entries.translation_en: Brown: A cute girl like you is the boss here?! Give me a break!

entries.text_jp: あんたみたいな クラくて
entries.translation_en: Ayase: A gloomy, weak-looking nerd like you can't be the boss!

entries.text_jp: 超 弱そうなのが
entries.translation_en: Ayase: You're totally weak, no way you're the guardian!

entries.text_jp: 今スグ 殺しちゃいますよ…
entries.translation_en: Kumi: I'm going to kill you right now... you fools.

entries.text_jp: もう いいわ
entries.translation_en: Kumi: That's enough. Disappear from before my eyes!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:なッ!? この殺気!!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What?! This murderous intent!!

entries.text_jp: なんて まがまがしい…気…
entries.translation_en: Elly: What an ominous, sinister aura...!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:ペ…ペルソナ!?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: P-Persona?! She's summoning a monster!!

entries.text_jp: 手加減抜きだよ みんな!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: No holding back, everyone! Let's go!!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:…ふん!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: ...Hmph! Looks like this is the top floor!

entries.text_jp: ここが ゴ{204}ルのようだね
entries.translation_en: Yukino: End of the line, "Kumi Hirose"!

entries.text_jp: ｜広臘 久美』さんや!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Prepare yourself, Kumi!

entries.text_jp: 久美:とうとう
entries.translation_en: Kumi: You have finally arrived... trapped in dull reality.

entries.text_jp: また 信じようともしない
entries.translation_en: Kumi: Refusing to believe in the paradise of dreams.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:バカはどっちだ…!?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Which of us is the fool...?! Fleeing from reality itself!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:久美ちゃん…
entries.translation_en: Brown: Kumi-chan... Fighting a cute girl breaks my heart!

entries.text_jp: でも 汢方ねェよな…
entries.translation_en: Brown: But for justice and the school, take this beatdown!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:へへ{204}んだ!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Heh-heh! Five against one, you don't stand a chance!

entries.text_jp: 久美:他人を見かけだけでしか
entries.translation_en: Kumi: Judging others purely by appearances... You fools!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:何!あれは!?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What is that?! Was Hypnos not a product of her dream?!
Elly: Could it be?! Hypnos was controlling Kumi-san's dream!

entries.text_jp: さぁ 夢の宇にまで私を
いじめにきた あいつらを
エンリョは いらないね!
か     り してもらうからな!
ゆきの:あんたの莫けだよ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: ...

entries.text_jp: もう いないんだ
まだ やるかい?
アタシは いっこうに
羨く つまらんものだ
自らの 手で
ブラウン:おれ達の実力で
entries.translation_en: Brown: ...

entries.text_jp: 大勝刮だった ワケだけど…
アヤセ:やった{204}!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: ...

entries.text_jp: ほ みたか!
久美:みなさん ホントに
訪惑になんか のらないで…
それが わかっただけでも
が 夢に逃げては
エリ{204}:Kumiさん
entries.translation_en: Elly: Kumi-san,

entries.text_jp: もう 弱い人間なんかじゃ…
ありませんわ
久美:ありがとう…
entries.translation_en: Kumi: Thank you...

entries.text_jp: 一人でも
私のそばに いてくれたなら…
entries.translation_en: Kumi: If only friends like you had been by my side...

entries.text_jp: ほ …さようなら
entries.translation_en: Kumi: ...Goodbye, everyone.

entries.text_jp: 1茴 手に入れた
entries.translation_en: Obtained 1 Mirror Shard.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:｜広臘 久美』…
entries.translation_en: Yukino: "Kumi Hirose"... She was just another victim of the mask.

entries.text_jp: さぁ 帰ろう!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Let's head back! We have to save Saeko-sensei!

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生を はやく
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Hurry, before it's too late!

entries.text_jp: ヒュプノスの塔 を
entries.translation_en: Tower of Hypnos conquered!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:久美ちゃん…
entries.translation_en: Brown: Kumi-chan... May you find peace.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:なんか こう
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Feels like an ominous presence is watching us...

entries.text_jp: ごきけんよう みなさま
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Good day, ladies and gentlemen. Welcome to this tower.

entries.text_jp: よくぞ この塔に
entries.translation_en: Michiko: I welcome you from the bottom of my heart.

entries.text_jp: 手達など 雪の女王の
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Borrowing the Snow Queen's authority, you petty fox!

entries.text_jp: すぎん 小者なのだからな!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: You are nothing more than a small fry!

entries.text_jp: おおかた この塔の
entries.translation_en: Elly: Are you the Guardian of this tower?
Ayase: That's right! Too scared of Ayase to show your face!

entries.text_jp: 超 ついてるッて感じ!?
entries.translation_en: Ayase: The boss here sounds totally weak and pathetic!

entries.text_jp: なんて なんて
entries.translation_en: Michiko: My, my, what delightfully insolent little brats!

entries.text_jp: おろかなクセに よく状える
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Weak fools shatter so quickly when tormented!

entries.text_jp: イジメがいが ありそうね
entries.translation_en: Michiko: You'll make such delightful playthings!

entries.text_jp: 遏履しないで すみそうですわ!
entries.translation_en: Michiko: I won't have to hold back in the slightest!

entries.text_jp: あんまり 弱い梠手は
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Weak opponents break so fast when bullied!

entries.text_jp: イジメると すぐに
entries.translation_en: Michiko: It's almost boring how fast they crumble!

entries.text_jp: ｜松乎 美智子』ですわ
entries.translation_en: Michiko: I am "Michiko Matsudaira", guardian of Nemesis!

entries.text_jp: ほ あなたよ!!
entries.translation_en: Michiko: You there!! Wouldn't you rather be my pet?

entries.text_jp: まぁ まぁ
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Rather than dying with these wretches!

entries.text_jp: ほ  俺のコトかぁ!?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: You mean ME?! Become a pet to a woman with an attitude like yours?!

entries.text_jp: ほ しかも手達のように
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: And to someone as hideous in personality as you?!

entries.text_jp: ほ 容姿も!!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Don't you dare insult me, you wretched woman!

entries.text_jp: この南茱 舌をなめるなよ!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I, Kei Nanjo, will make you regret uttering such words!

entries.text_jp: 地獄で 後恒させてくれる!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: You shall regret this in the depths of hell!

entries.text_jp: ほ おれ達なの??
entries.translation_en: Brown: You mean the great me?? Make "Brown-sama" your pet?!

entries.text_jp: ほ ペットにするだと
entries.translation_en: Brown: Making fun of me like that! I'll give your ugly face some surgery!

entries.text_jp: その ブス顔
entries.translation_en: Brown: I'll beat that ugly mug of yours into next week!

entries.text_jp: ほ 惰けを
entries.translation_en: Michiko: And here I offered you mercy, you insolent rabble!

entries.text_jp: …いいですわ 小尤ちゃん運…
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Very well, little brats... I shall break you with my own hands!

entries.text_jp: 一匹残らず ワタクシの手で
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Not a single one of you will leave here in one piece!

entries.text_jp: いま この塔の時間刷限を
entries.translation_en: Michiko: I have lifted the time limit on this tower!

entries.text_jp: では お待ちしてますわ!!
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Take as long as you like, I eagerly await your arrival! Farewell!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:松乎 美智子…
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Michiko Matsudaira... There's definitely a catch to lifting the time limit.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:時間刷限が無い?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: No time limit? Smells fishy to me.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:なんかさ{204}
entries.translation_en: Ayase: That Michiko chick reminds me of someone all stuck-up and high-and-mighty!

entries.text_jp: あの 美智子って女
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Michiko acts like she's the queen of the universe!

entries.text_jp: 超 えらそうなトコとか{204}
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Super haughty and arrogant!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:あの 旡犬吋に
entries.translation_en: Brown: She's the spitting image of a certain someone whose name starts with "Na"!

entries.text_jp: ここだけの話 あの女
entries.translation_en: Brown: Between you and me, she acts just like Nanjo!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:Time limitがない?
entries.translation_en: Elly: No time limit? We should remain very cautious.

entries.text_jp: いずれにせよ 何かしらウラが
entries.translation_en: Elly: There is unquestionably some hidden trap behind this.

entries.text_jp: Time limitのこと…
entries.translation_en: Elly: We had better not let our guard down regarding the time limit.

entries.text_jp: 悪魔旡生:おいッ誰がこぼして
entries.translation_en: Demon Teacher: Hey! Who said you could spill that milk, de-gowasu?!

entries.text_jp: ほ 飲みまくるザマす
entries.translation_en: Demon Teacher: Milk is good for you! Drink it all, little piggy!

entries.text_jp: それから そっちの咆鍖!
entries.translation_en: Demon Teacher: And you over there, four-eyes! Drop your chest to the floor on those push-ups!

entries.text_jp: また ノルマを
entries.translation_en: Demon Teacher: Or I'll double your quota, de-gowasu!

entries.text_jp: ほ たすけて!!
entries.translation_en: Toro: S-Save meee!!

entries.text_jp: ほ ゆるして!!
entries.translation_en: Toro: Forgive meee!!

entries.text_jp: ほ ぼくは
entries.translation_en: Toro: I just...

entries.text_jp: ほ だけは!
entries.translation_en: Toro: anything but this!

entries.text_jp: ほ 襞品だけは!!
entries.translation_en: Toro: Dairy products are my absolute nightmare!!

entries.text_jp: ほ ゼっ
entries.translation_en: Toro: I can't take another drop!!

entries.text_jp: ほ やっぱり
entries.translation_en: Kurokawa: As I thought...

entries.text_jp: ほ ダメなのらァ{204}
entries.translation_en: Kurokawa: I can't do push-ups~

entries.text_jp: ほ 僕のように
entries.translation_en: Kurokawa: Someone meant for brain work like me...

entries.text_jp: ほ 腹脳労鼬の傑合う
entries.translation_en: Kurokawa: was never built for physical labor!

entries.text_jp: ほ 腕は
entries.translation_en: Kurokawa: My arms are turning into jelly!

entries.text_jp: ほ できてはいないのだ!
entries.translation_en: Kurokawa: My body wasn't made for this!

entries.text_jp: ほ ブシュウゥゥっ
entries.translation_en: Kurokawa: *wheeeeze*

entries.text_jp: お前ら 学枚にいたんじゃ!?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Weren't you two supposed to be back at school?!

entries.text_jp: ほ やだ!
entries.translation_en: Toro: Noooo!

entries.text_jp: ほ ヤメてよゥ!!
entries.translation_en: Toro: Stop it pleaseee!!

entries.text_jp: ほ 迅んじゃう…ョう
entries.translation_en: Toro: I'm gonna die...!

entries.text_jp: ほ もっと飲むザマすよ!
entries.translation_en: Demon Teacher: Drink more, little piglet, de-gowasu!

entries.text_jp: ほ 牛乳を飲むために
entries.translation_en: Demon Teacher: Become a milk-drinking machine, de-gowasu!

entries.text_jp: もう できないよほォォォ…
entries.translation_en: Toro: I can't drink any moreee...

entries.text_jp: ほ あははぁ…
entries.translation_en: Kurokawa: Ahahaha... I see fairies...

entries.text_jp: ほ ええへ…
entries.translation_en: Kurokawa: Mommy, is that you...?

entries.text_jp: 悪魔旡生:こぉら!
entries.translation_en: Demon Teacher: Hey! Don't break before Lady Michiko gets to break you, de-gowasu!

entries.text_jp: ほ というか
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Torture purely calculated around their specific weaknesses...

entries.text_jp: ほ というか…
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Truly sadistic and terrifying.

entries.text_jp: トロ:ぉホゲぇッ!!
entries.translation_en: Toro: Bleeeaaargh!!

entries.text_jp: ほ あれ?
entries.translation_en: Toro: Huh?

entries.text_jp: ほ アアア綾臘さん!
entries.translation_en: Toro: A-A-Ayase-san! Everyone!

entries.text_jp: ほ たたた肪けて!
entries.translation_en: Toro: S-S-Save meee!

entries.text_jp: そう だから
entries.translation_en: Michiko: That is because they are ugly! Ugliness is a sin!

entries.text_jp: ウツクシイ このワタクシが!
entries.translation_en: Michiko: And I, the beautiful Michiko, am passing judgment on them!

entries.text_jp: 今 貮いているのよ!
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Punishing their hideous existence!

entries.text_jp: ほ いうか?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Sorry to disappoint, but ugly or not, they are our schoolmates.

entries.text_jp: ほ できん
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: We cannot overlook this cruelty. Release them!

entries.text_jp: さぁ クサリの鍵
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Unlock those chains and stop this torture right now!

entries.text_jp: ほ エ{204}がァああッ
entries.translation_en: Brown: What did you say?! You ugly hag, pick on someone your own size!

entries.text_jp: 美智子:まぁ{204}!なんて
entries.translation_en: Michiko: My, my! What touching friendship! How delightful!

entries.text_jp: では そのうるわし{204}い
entries.translation_en: Michiko: If you wish to save your friends,

entries.text_jp: そう!この ワタクシが
entries.translation_en: Michiko: race up to my chamber on the top floor before they expire! Ohohoho!

entries.text_jp: 念いで ワタクシの斯までくる事ですわね!オホホホッ!
entries.translation_en: Michiko: The key is waiting in a grand treasure chest!

entries.text_jp: ワタクシのお部厘は すぐ…
entries.translation_en: Michiko: My room is just at the top floor... Farewell!

entries.text_jp: ｜鍖の破片』は 大きな宝箱に
entries.translation_en: Michiko: The "Mirror Shard" is also in a large treasure chest~

entries.text_jp: ほ ね
entries.translation_en: Michiko: If you can make it in time, that is!

entries.text_jp: では ごきげんよう!
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Farewell, little heroes!

entries.text_jp: トロ:たすけてください!
entries.translation_en: Toro: P-Please save me! Ayase-san!

entries.text_jp: ほ ぼくの
entries.translation_en: Toro: My heart belongs only to you!

entries.text_jp: ほ 沚の鍵は
entries.translation_en: Toro: The key to my heart is yours!

entries.text_jp: 悪魔旡生:おらおら!
entries.translation_en: Demon Teacher: Come on, keep drinking and pushing, de-gowasu!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:ほっとけないけど
entries.translation_en: Yukino: We can't leave them like this! We gotta find that key fast!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:美智子…
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Michiko... She's utterly vile.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:トロと黒瓜には
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Toro and Kurokawa are pathetic, but Michiko is way worse!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:俺は｜鍖の破片』よりも
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Rather than the Mirror Shard, saving our schoolmates comes first.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:ヤな奴等だけど
entries.translation_en: Brown: They're annoying dorks, but they're our classmates! Let's save 'em!

entries.text_jp: あの Michiko…!
entries.translation_en: Elly: That Michiko... Her cruelty knows no bounds.

entries.text_jp: ほ だめ…
entries.translation_en: Toro: No more milk... I'm gonna burst...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:なんなんだい?!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: What the hell?! Is this chest empty?!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:あの美智子のことだ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Knowing that Michiko, she filled the tower with fake chests.

entries.text_jp: に しても…擇聞部厘から
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: We must hurry back to the torture room.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:これがMichikoの言う
entries.translation_en: Elly: Is this what Michiko meant by lifting the time limit?

entries.text_jp: Very hardでしたわ…
entries.translation_en: Elly: It was a trap to make us waste precious time!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:う{204}もう迅ぬ!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Ugh, I'm gonna die! Running up and down these stairs!

entries.text_jp: 入ってなかったら アヤセ運ィ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: If the key isn't in this chest, Ayase's gonna explode!

entries.text_jp: 超 くたびれ掲じゃ{204}ん!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: All this running around is totally exhausting!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:しかし みるからに
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: But this chest looks distinctly different from the fakes.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:なァ{204}んか コレ
おれ達は 内向吋だしぃ
女じゃないから パスな
ゆきの:ウダウダ言っていても
entries.translation_en: Yukino: ...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:時間刷限が無い
entries.translation_en: Yukino: ...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:もうダメ!!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: ...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:さすがの俺も
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Even I

entries.text_jp: また あの擇聞部厘のトコ

たァ{204}ッぷり 返してやるぜッ

entries.translation_en: Ayase: ...

entries.text_jp: でかいツラしてんのだけは
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Acting all high and mighty is just unbearable!

entries.text_jp: やっぱぁ MMCッて
entries.translation_en: Ayase: In the end, arrogant rich girls are the worst!

entries.text_jp: やはり アンタ運のような
entries.translation_en: Michiko: To think lowborn rabble like you reached my chamber!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:｜おうおう』うるさいぞ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: "Ohoho," how noisy. Cease your arrogant cackling!

entries.text_jp: ま しかし綾臘の言うとおりだ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Ayase is correct. Your vanity is repulsive.

entries.text_jp: ほ そんなもの!!
entries.translation_en: Michiko: How dare you insult my beauty!!

entries.text_jp: この械の宇には 絶対
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Beauty is absolute in this world!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:いっちょまえに
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Acting like a queen when you're just a puppet of the mask!

entries.text_jp: その顔はネ ワタクシの
entries.translation_en: Michiko: This face was given to me by the Snow Queen!

entries.text_jp: そして アンタ運の
entries.translation_en: Michiko: And your ugly faces will be wiped out!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:なんだと?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What did you say?!

entries.text_jp: オイ こらテメ!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Hey, shut your trap, you conceited witch!

entries.text_jp: そして 塔が嗅い部げた
entries.translation_en: The tower trembles with demonic power!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:曜かにすごいパワ{204}だ!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Indeed, her power is astonishing!

entries.text_jp: Michikoは ただ
entries.translation_en: Elly: Michiko is being consumed by Nemesis!

entries.text_jp: 美智子:さぁ
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Now then... fall into eternal despair!

entries.text_jp: ほ ｜後恒』をォ!
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Savor your regrets in death!

entries.text_jp: ほ ｜愎悪』をォ!
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Taste my vengeance!

entries.text_jp: ほ もっとォ!!
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Suffer more, you ugly worms!!

entries.text_jp: とっては たまらない
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Your screams are music to my ears!

entries.text_jp: ほ ペルソナかい?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Is that your Persona, or the monster within you?!

entries.text_jp: もう しかたないよッ!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: We have no choice but to take her down!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:ここがどうやら
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Looks like this is the end of the line for you, Michiko!

entries.text_jp: でも こうまで箸単に
entries.translation_en: Michiko: How could I lose so easily to these peasants?!

entries.text_jp: ワタクシのしかけたワナに
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Even after all my brilliant traps!

entries.text_jp: この ワタクシに
entries.translation_en: Michiko: To defeat ME, the magnificent Michiko Matsudaira!

entries.text_jp: アンタ運は 自分の手で
entries.translation_en: Michiko: You filthy brats!

entries.text_jp: 美智子 笶いが止まりませんわ
entries.translation_en: Michiko: I will make you pay for this humiliation!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:なんだと?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What did you say?!

entries.text_jp: 友人運が 禾てくれない
entries.translation_en: Michiko: If only friends had reached out to me back then...

entries.text_jp: それも たぁッぷりとねェ!
entries.translation_en: Michiko: I absorbed so much power from the tower!

entries.text_jp: それも アンタ運が時間をかけてここに禾てくれたおかげですわ
entries.translation_en: Michiko: All thanks to you taking your sweet time getting here!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:曜かにすごいパワ{204}だ!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Indeed, her power has swelled dramatically!

entries.text_jp: 美智子:さぁ
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Now, perish under Nemesis' wrath!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:ふん!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Hmph! Take this!!

entries.text_jp: 美智子:わ ワタクシが
entries.translation_en: Michiko: I... I lost...?!

entries.text_jp: ま 莫けるなんて!
entries.translation_en: Michiko: How could I be defeated...?!

entries.text_jp: こんな 人間鳳惰に…
entries.translation_en: Michiko: By mere humans like them...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:やかましい女だ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What an obnoxious woman.

entries.text_jp: 手達が莫け 俺運が勝ったのは
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: That you lost and we prevailed is an undeniable reality.

entries.text_jp: 岡げようのない 現実
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Face the reality of your defeat.

entries.text_jp: いや 消えてくれ
entries.translation_en: Michiko: No... disappear... Leave me alone!

entries.text_jp: 葺 理由もなく
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Back then, without reason, everyone called me ugly and ridiculed me...

entries.text_jp: か弱いワタクシを 菷り
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Mocking a frail, defenseless girl...

entries.text_jp: そんなワタクシにやさしく
entries.translation_en: Michiko: The only one who was gentle to me was the Snow Queen!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:それは…全面吋に
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: That is... while your pain may be real, hurting others to soothe your grudge is inexcusable.

entries.text_jp: 本当に あなた…
entries.translation_en: Elly: Michiko-san, true beauty comes from within the heart.

entries.text_jp: かなり おかしいですわ…
entries.translation_en: Elly: Lashing out at the world will never heal your scars.

entries.text_jp: この 痕なしでは
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Without this mask and power, I am nothing...

entries.text_jp: まだ ワタクシを
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Are you still mocking me?!

entries.text_jp: もう よろしくってよ!!
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Farewell, you wretches!!

entries.text_jp: 今 冉び時をへて梼ちた時!
entries.translation_en: Michiko: When the curse is broken, I shall fade away!

entries.text_jp: ワタクシは アンタ運に
entries.translation_en: Michiko: I leave the Mirror Shard with you...

entries.text_jp: 2茴 手に入れた
entries.translation_en: Obtained 2 Mirror Shards.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:松乎 美智子…
entries.translation_en: Yukino: "Michiko Matsudaira"... What a tragic girl.

entries.text_jp: できれば もう二痍と
entries.translation_en: Yukino: I hope we never have to fight a classmate like that again.

entries.text_jp: 黠局 鍵なんて
entries.translation_en: Yukino: In the end, the real treasure was saving our friends.

entries.text_jp: さ 帰ろう!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Let's head back!

entries.text_jp: ネメシスの塔 を
entries.translation_en: Tower of Nemesis conquered!

entries.text_jp: 塔に入った時息で
entries.translation_en: Upon entering the tower, the trial begins.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:いきなり
entries.translation_en: Yukino: What the...?! A voice from out of nowhere?!
???: Yahoo~! Welcome to Thanatos Tower!

entries.text_jp: ｜山本 巨合子』ちゃん
entries.translation_en: Yuriko: It's your lovely host, "Yuriko Yamamoto"-chan!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:何の定談だ?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What manner of foolish joke is this?!

entries.text_jp: 手達 もっと
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Show yourself if you are the guardian!

entries.text_jp: ほ ちゃ{204}ん!
entries.translation_en: Yuriko: Call me Yuriko-chan~!

entries.text_jp: ほ …違う
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: ...Preposterous.

entries.text_jp: って 何なんだよ!テメ!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Hey! What's your deal, talking like some wacky TV host?!

entries.text_jp: しかも しゃべり方変だしィ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Her way of talking is super weird, like totally bizarre!

entries.text_jp: あんた 超ヘン みたいな!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Like, you're crazy weird, honestly!

entries.text_jp: ほ よねぇ{204}!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Right?! Totally nuts!

entries.text_jp: ほ なんだ!?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Who are you?! Show yourself!

entries.text_jp: ほ 手達 ココで
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Do you intend to challenge us right here?!

entries.text_jp: 一貰 交えようと言うのか?!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Do you wish to cross blades with us?!

entries.text_jp: コワいこと言っちゃ イヤイヤ
entries.translation_en: Yuriko: Don't say such scary things, no no no~!

entries.text_jp: じゃあ よく聞いてね
entries.translation_en: Yuriko: Listen carefully to the rules of this tower!

entries.text_jp: 講庄ぁ{204} なんちゃってぇ!
entries.translation_en: Yuriko: Just kidding! Tee-hee!

entries.text_jp: じゃあ ガンバって
entries.translation_en: Yuriko: Do your best to solve the candle puzzle and reach me!

entries.text_jp: にしても かなり
entries.translation_en: Yukino: She's definitely up to no good.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:何だか 気持ち悪いね
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Something about her gives me the creeps.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:クソぉッ!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Damn it! Another trap?!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:何なのォ!?
entries.translation_en: Ayase: What is with this girl?! Totally conniving!

entries.text_jp: あの 腹ワルそォな齟ォ?
entries.translation_en: Ayase: That sneaky little brat!

entries.text_jp: 超 人生ナメてるッて
entries.translation_en: Ayase: She totally treats life like a silly game!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:まったく…
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Good grief... A guardian who relies entirely on deceit and trickery.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:なぁなぁ
entries.translation_en: Brown: Hey, hey! We gotta be careful with these candles!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:あのYurikoと
entries.translation_en: Elly: That Yuriko... She thrives on misleading us with traps.

entries.text_jp: するコトを Trapに
entries.translation_en: Elly: Turning our own choices into traps!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:ウゥッ?!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Ugh?! The door won't budge!

entries.text_jp: ほ だい?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Is this the right one?

entries.text_jp: ほ から
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Which candle flame should we put out?

entries.text_jp: ほ く
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Extinguish it!
Yuriko: Yay, yaaay~! You fell right into my trap!

entries.text_jp: じゃ たしかに
entries.translation_en: Yuriko: As promised, I'll take your Persona!

entries.text_jp: ほ もらったよ{204}ん
entries.translation_en: Yuriko: Persona taken away~!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:チックショウ!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Damn it all! She sealed our Persona!!

entries.text_jp: ロウソクの米を消しますか?
entries.translation_en: Will you extinguish the candle flame?

entries.text_jp: このロウソクの米を
entries.translation_en: Extinguish this candle flame?

entries.text_jp: ロウソクに 米はついていない
entries.translation_en: The candle is unlit.

entries.text_jp: ロウソクに 米がついている
entries.translation_en: The candle is burning.

entries.text_jp: どちらかのロウソクの
entries.translation_en: Extinguish the flame of either candle?

entries.text_jp: 扉はもう自由に闢く
entries.translation_en: The door now opens freely.

entries.text_jp: 扉を闢きますか?
entries.translation_en: Will you open the door?

entries.text_jp: みそ  うおべはなァ{204}んて
entries.translation_en: Yuriko: Oh, were you fooled again? Too bad~!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:あからさまに
entries.translation_en: Yukino: That is so blatantly suspicious!

entries.text_jp: 同じようにワナだね きっと
entries.translation_en: Yukino: It's definitely another trap, without a doubt!

entries.text_jp: 巨合子:あ{204}んひどい ひどい
entries.translation_en: Yuriko: Aww, that's so mean! So mean!

entries.text_jp: せっかくぅ 巨合子が
entries.translation_en: Yuriko: After Yuriko prepared such a nice hint for you!
